description: A black USB hub with several ports lies on the desk, with a loose cable and plug end stretched out in front of a pillow. The left hand slides in toward the hub while the right hand comes in from the right; both hands steady the hub as a two-hand object, and the right hand grips the plug near the hub, lifts it slightly, then pulls it outward to remove it and lets it rest on the desk while the left hand releases.
